name: FDW Championship
epitaph: Crush!'s own top championship, decided in a ten-man Battle Royal on the brand's own first show (1 November 2007) and won by Rated R, the last man standing after nine eliminations.

name: FDW Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Won by Pedro_RKO and Mr.Xtreme Hardcore over Lord and Rated R on Crush!'s own first show (1 November 2007), Pedro_RKO turning on his own partner to secure the win.

name: National Championship
epitaph: A vacant title contested on Crush!'s own first show (1 November 2007); Mr.X.Division won it over Ricardo_619 with a reversal into a Stunner.

name: World Championship
epitaph: Sacrifice's own top championship, vacant as of the brand's own first show (2 November 2007), which staged two qualifying matches (Jead over Blackthorn; Kurte$ over Brunovsky) for a title match the following week between Jead and Kurte$; the promotion's own 8 November 2007 champions list still records it as vacant ("Ainda não há"), so this title match's own outcome is not established by any document read.

name: European Championship
epitaph: Named as vacant ("Ainda não há") on Sacrifice's own 8 November 2007 champions list; no contest for it survives in the documents held here.

name: Sacrifice Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Won by Kajo and Spartan over Manu Original Punk and Great One on Sacrifice's own first show (2 November 2007).
